message: - **You push it**, Instructions: Library → open each video → ⋯ menu above the player → Download (paid plans only, Business/Business+ AI/Enterprise; one video per click, lands as an .mp4). For workspace metadata: Workspace settings → Data tab → Export CSV for Engagement Insights and activity logs, and Members view → Export for the member list.
notes: Video downloads require a paid plan and are one video per click; there is no bulk export.
Engagement Insights and activity logs export as CSV summaries, not raw event data.
